articles.title: Nigeria’s Bloccpay is a global, stablecoin-powered payroll, invoicing platform - Disrupt Africa
articles.text:
Nigerian startup Bloccpay is a global, stablecoin-powered payroll and invoicing platform that helps businesses automate payroll for distributed teams and make it easier for professionals in emerging markets to get paid, manage their income, and build a documented financial history.
Founded by CEO Ajoke Asunmonu and CTO Jennifer Echenim in 2022, Bloccpay allows companies to set up their account, add their talent, and set a pay frequency, and from that point, all they need to do on each pay cycle is review and approve. The platform generates the payroll, debits the business, and credits the talent.
On the talent side, freelancers and contractors can invoice clients globally and receive payments through both fiat and crypto channels, into a bank account, a crypto wallet, or mobile money, depending on the market. Their clients don’t need a Bloccpay account to pay them. They simply receive a payment link and settle the invoice from there.
“But beyond the payment itself, transactions generate a history of work done and income received. Over time, that becomes the kind of record that’s requested when someone opens a bank account in another country, applies for a loan, or supports a visa application, the proof of income and employment that freelancers rarely have on hand. For us, that documentation layer is just as important as the payment,” Echenim told Disrupt Africa.
But Bloccpay’s vision goes past payroll.
“We want Bloccpay to be a one-stop platform for managing income and everyday life. Payroll and invoicing are where we’ve started, but the roadmap includes health insurance, yield products, and other benefits traditionally reserved for full-time employees, extended to the freelancers and contractors who have historically been locked out of them,” Echenim said.
The startup’s origins are personal to her.
“I had been working remotely for international companies and struggling to access money I had earned. I had to send my USD earnings to a friend’s dollar account, who then converted the money to stablecoins through a peer-to-peer transaction and sent the stablecoins to me,” Echenim said.
“I then had to use another peer-to-peer transaction to convert the stablecoins into naira because the platform I was paid through offered an exchange rate that was about 40 per cent worse. That meant three separate steps, two intermediaries and delays at each stage, just to access money I had already earned. I went through that process several times, sometimes using Ajoke’s account, and eventually Ajoke and I had to ask ourselves what it would take to fix it.”
The pair started researching the problem, and found that many cross-border workers in Africa and other emerging markets were facing the same challenges, using multiple platforms, currencies, and workarounds just to get paid and maintain a portable financial record.
“That gave us the confidence that this was bigger than our own experience. We grabbed a notebook, mapped out the payment flow, and started thinking about what we could remove or simplify. We spoke with a blockchain engineer to pressure-test the idea, then began customer discovery with remote teams, freelancers, and HR managers before writing any code,” Echenim said.
Although Bloccpay was registered in 2022, the company began operations in 2024, when it launched its private beta. Asunmonu said the startup had essentially spotted two gaps sitting on top of each other.
“The first was about professionals in emerging markets earning from global businesses but losing money to fees, exchange rates, and the friction of moving funds via traditional rails,” he said.
“The second was the documentation gap. Traditional employment generates a financial record as a byproduct: payslips, recurring credits from a named employer. Independent and cross-border work generates nothing like that. Whatever records exist are scattered across payment platforms, currencies and employers, and none of them reads as proof of income to a bank or a consulate.”
There were already players solving parts of the problem. Some handled global payments, others were remittance platforms focused on moving money. But the platforms that moved money stopped the moment it landed. Almost nobody was building what came next, which is a financial record the worker could carry across currencies, platforms, and work histories.
“A lot of existing solutions were also designed for the sender, the business initiating the payment. The recipient’s experience, particularly in an emerging market, was almost secondary. We started from the other end, asking what workers actually need. Not just to receive money, but to use it, prove it, and build a financial history with it over time,” Asunmonu said.
Bloccpay is still in private beta, but in that period it has processed over US$400,000 in gross transaction volume, serving close to 300 users.
“But the number that matters most to us right now is the trajectory. In Q2 2026, our gross transaction volume grew sevenfold compared with the previous quarter. By the end of the first half of 2026, we had already matched our total transaction volume for all of 2025,” said Echenim.
“The users we have are engaged. Many people moved to Bloccpay from other platforms, which tells us we’re solving a real problem. We also have direct support relationships with many of our users, so we hear from them when something needs improvement. That feedback has shaped several product decisions, including backdated payroll, mid-cycle contractor additions, and mobile money integration.”
The startup has largely been bootstrapped.
“That has meant doing more with less for longer than we’d like, but it’s also meant building on our own timeline rather than someone else’s,” said Echenim.
That said, it has received a US$100,000 grant from the Stellar Community Fund Build Award, joined the Techstars Founder Catalyst Programme, and become members of the Circle Alliance Program, which has supported its stablecoin infrastructure and partnerships.
“Each of those has given us something different: capital, structure, and access to the stablecoin ecosystem we’re building on,” Echenim said.
Bloccpay currently has active users in Nigeria, Kenya, Ghana, and South Africa, its primary talent markets, with payouts also live in Uganda and Tanzania. Its business customers are primarily based in the US and UK.
“Once we open it up to the public, distribution becomes the priority. We want to deepen our presence in existing markets, expand payment and payout corridors, and add more local payout options. The goal is to reach talent wherever they are and pay them through the channels that work locally. With the right investment, we also want to grow the team and accelerate both the product roadmap and market expansion,” said Asunmonu.
The startup charges US$15 per contractor per month; invoicing carries a one per cent fee per invoice; and withdrawals are also charged at one per cent. Deposits are free.
“While transaction volume growth through 2026 has been encouraging, we’d rather talk about revenue once the business is operating at the scale we’re building for. The fee model is also only the starting point. As we add yield products, cards, and benefits, the revenue mix broadens well beyond payroll subscriptions and transaction fees,” Echenim said.

articles.title: Xiaomi 18 Pro & Pro Max : écrans dorsaux, filtre de confidentialité, Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6… et un lancement international
articles.text:
Xiaomi 18 Pro & Pro Max : écrans dorsaux, filtre de confidentialité, Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6… et un lancement international
Les dernières puces de Qualcomm sont officielles, et le bal des smartphones les intégrant peut commencer. Xiaomi saisit l'occasion pour présenter ses 18 Pro et Pro Max, dotés des Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 et truffés de fonctionnalités premium. La marque les réserve pour l'heure à la Chine, mais évoque un lancement international avant la fin de l'année.
Le Snapdragon Summit de Qualcomm bat son plein, ce qui est synonyme de l’annonce de la plateforme Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 et de sa version Extreme. Et, forcément, de l’apparition de premiers smartphones équipés des chipsets. Partenaire habituel de l’américain, Xiaomi dégaine ainsi sa série chiffrée, en version 18 : les Xiaomi 18 Pro et 18 Pro Max font leurs débuts en Chine pour l’occasion. Le premier est équipé du Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 et le second, du Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6. Deux puces, rappelons-le, gravées en 2 nm et dotées de cœurs Prime atteignant les 5 GHz.
Ce que l’on retient en premier lieu, c’est l’annonce de Xiaomi : sa série Pro sera commercialisée à l’international en 2026. Les détails de son plan d’action doivent être précisés, mais on peut espérer que la France soit concernée, et au moins pour la version Pro. Rappelons que l’an dernier, les 17 Pro et Pro Max n’ont pas atteint les rayonnages hexagonaux, le fabricant préférant miser sur le 17 classique et sur sa version Ultra.
Les Xiaomi 18 Pro et Pro Max héritent d’un attribut inauguré par les 17 Pro : un écran dorsal de 2,4 pouces (18 Pro) et 2,9 pouces (18 Pro Max), reposant sur la technologie Amoled et promettant d’exécuter de petites applications. Les deux smartphones sont globalement similaires, si ce n’est que le Pro Max est plus grand, ce qui lui permet d’accueillir une batterie plus généreuse, et qu’il bénéficie d’une puce aux performances graphiques boostées. Côté Pro Max donc, on retrouve un afficheur de 6,9 pouces et une batterie de 8500 mAh - rappelons que les capacités des modèles vendus à l’international sont en général revues à la baisse -, tandis que le modèle Pro lui préfère une dalle de 6,4 pouces et une batterie de 7000 mAh. Son poids s’en ressent : comptez 235 g pour le premier et 203 g pour le second.
Deux écrans et une technologie pensée pour la vie privée
Les deux appareils partagent le reste de leur fiche technique : tous deux équipés d’HyperOS 4, ils sont munis de trois modules photo dorsaux. Deux capteurs de 200 mégapixels sont ainsi dédiés au grand-angle et au téléobjectif x5, tandis qu’un module ultra grand-angle complète le trio, avec ses 50 mégapixels. Leica reste bien entendu associé à ce bloc photo pour le moins soigné, qui permet d’ailleurs de filmer jusqu’en 8K à 30 i/s.
Autre élément, et pas des moindres, partagé par les deux smartphones : un écran de confidentialité, déjà vu - en Chine du moins - sur le smartphone pliant 18 Fold. Les terminaux disposent donc de l’homologue du Privacy Display du Galaxy S26 Ultra de Samsung, et peuvent masquer aux regards indiscrets les applications sensibles ou l’intégralité de leur contenu, selon les besoins de l’utilisateur.
Du premium au niveau tarifaire
Les deux smartphones sont d’ores et déjà disponibles en Chine. Il faut compter un minimum de 5999 yuans (environ 785 € au taux de change actuel, hors taxes) pour un Xiaomi 18 Pro 12/256 Go. Les effets de la crise de la RAM et du stockage se font donc ressentir, puisque son prédécesseur, le 17 Pro, coûtait 1000 yuans de moins à configuration égale. Quant au 18 Pro Max, il est annoncé à partir de 6999 yuans (environ 916 €), alors que le 17 Pro Max démarrait à 5999 yuans… en 12/512 Go. Les tarifs en euros restent bien évidemment à confirmer à l’occasion du lancement des appareils à l’international.

articles.title: Cómo ha cambiado el valor de la criptomoneda ethereum en las últimas 24 horas
articles.text:
Ether, comúnmente llamada como ethereum, es la moneda digital #2 en cuanto a términos de capitalización de mercado, por lo que se trata de una de las divisas digitales que más despierta el interés entre los mineros (creadores de las criptodivisas).
Ethereum es una plataforma de blockchain de código abierto que se ejecuta con el uso de su moneda nativa, llamada ether o ETH, por lo que a pesar de que la gente usa estos nombres como sinónimos son cosas distintas.
PUBLICIDAD
Ether es un token que se utiliza específicamente en la blockchain ethereum para pagar transacciones. Este token es responsable de impulsar casi todo lo que ocurre en la red, misma que puede ser usada por cualquier persona para crear y ejecutar contratos inteligentes, que son programas de software que se ejecutan de manera autónoma y sin la intervención del usuario.
De acuerdo con el portal de Binance, la moneda digital solana actualmente cuenta con 122.1M de unidades creadas.
El precio de la criptomoneda de ethereum para este día a las 14:05 horas (UTC) es de 2662.65 dólares por unidad.
Esto quiere decir que el activo digital tuvo un cambio del -1.9 el último día, así como una variación del 0.0 % en la última hora.
PUBLICIDAD
Actualmente, ethereum se encuentra en el lugar #2 de popularidad en el mercado digital. Cabe mencionar que el máximo histórico que ha alcanzado esta divisa digital es de 4891.7 dólares por unidad.
Cotización de la criptomoneda Ethereum
Ethereum 2.0: las claves
Tras varios meses de retraso y con el temor de que ya nunca pasaría, finalmente el 15 de septiembre de 2022 Ethereum llevó a cabo su tan ansiada fusión o actualización al nuevo nivel 2.0 con la promesa de mejorar la experiencia de los usuarios de esta criptomoneda.
“The Merge”, inglés para “La Fusión”, es una transformación en la forma en que Ethereum procesa las transacciones y en cómo se crean nuevos tokens de Ether.
PUBLICIDAD
Esta fusión se trata de la combinación de la cadena de bloques de Ethereum con una nueva cadena de bloques separada conocido como proof-of-stake, el cual reduce el consumo de energía de la cadena de bloques de Ethereum en un 99,9 %, según sus propios desarrolladores, lo que la vuelve más “amigable” con el ambiente al tiempo que las transacciones serían más baratas.
Sus defensores creen que la fusión hará que Ethereum resulte favorecido con respecto al máximo rival, Bitcoin, pues podría aumentar su uso.
En el proceso Proof Stake los propietarios de Ether bloquearán cantidades establecidas de sus criptomonedas para verificar nuevos registros en la cadena de bloques, ganando nuevas monedas además de su criptografía “participada”.

articles.title: Microsoft revives the Surface Mouse with haptic feedback, six-month battery life
articles.text:
First look: At Qualcomm's Snapdragon Summit event in Maui, Hawaii, Microsoft unveiled multiple new Surface devices, including a 12-inch Surface Pro convertible and a 13-inch Surface Laptop. The company also debuted a redesigned Surface Mouse almost 10 years after the original model launched alongside the Surface Studio in November 2016.
The second-generation Surface Mouse includes several new features, including haptic feedback, which uses an internal vibration motor to deliver subtle pulses and tactile responses to confirm clicks. It can also provide feedback for on-screen interactions such as snapping windows to the edge of the screen or aligning objects and layouts in PowerPoint, Affinity, Concepts, Filmora, and other supported applications.
The new Surface Mouse also gets a customizable Action Button that summons Copilot by default but can also be configured to work with other actions and Windows shortcuts. According to Microsoft, the button can be used to launch any app or support any shortcut, but it can only be customized using the Microsoft Surface app.
The mouse supports Bluetooth 6.0 and can connect to multiple devices simultaneously, allowing users to move between them seamlessly. It sports a large battery that Microsoft claims can last up to six months on a single charge, meaning users won't have to recharge it frequently.
The new Surface Mouse has an ergonomic ambidextrous shape specially designed to be comfortable for both left-handed and right-handed users. The company highlighted that it's built with 30% recycled content, including more recycled plastic than previous models such as the 2025 Surface Arc Mouse and the 2018 Surface Precision Mouse.
The new Surface Mouse will go on sale on October 13 in Black and Platinum colorways. It is priced at $79.99, which is a steep hike over the $50 asking price for the original 2016 model, but Microsoft would likely justify the higher price by citing the additional features, customization options, and improved battery life.
Alongside the Surface Mouse, Microsoft also debuted the new Surface Pro and Surface Laptop, starting at $1,149.99 and $1,199, respectively. Both devices are powered by the Snapdragon X2 Plus SoC, which the company claims offers up to 18% more battery efficiency, over 60% faster graphics performance, and 95% faster on-device AI inference compared to the Snapdragon X Plus.

articles.title: Depois do Windows, Qualcomm agora aposta no Linux • Tecnoblog
articles.text:
Depois do Windows, Qualcomm agora aposta no Linux
Qualcomm anunciou suporte oficial ao Linux em computadores equipados com chips Snapdragon X2.
A Qualcomm introduziu os chips Snapdragon X em 2023 com a missão de fazer a arquitetura Arm ganhar espaço no segmento de PCs. Mas o foco sempre esteve no ecossistema do Windows. Até agora: a companhia acaba de anunciar o suporte ao Linux em computadores baseados na série Snapdragon X2.
É verdade que este é um “Early Developer Preview”, ou seja, o projeto está em fase de prévia para desenvolvedores. Isso significa que a novidade não é interessante para usuários “normais” no atual estágio. Atualmente, o objetivo é permitir que desenvolvedores criem, testem e otimizem software para Linux nessas máquinas.
Não é que já não fosse possível rodar Linux em notebooks equipados com processadores Snapdragon X. Isso é feito, essencialmente, via implementação ARM64 (AArch64) do kernel. O problema é que é preciso também oferecer suporte a componentes relacionados à CPU, como a GPU e a NPU. Sem apoio do fabricante, a comunidade Linux tem que se virar para isso.
O anúncio da Qualcomm chama a atenção porque, nele, a companhia afirma que está trabalhando para tornar os componentes relacionados à série Snapdragon X2 compatíveis com o Linux diretamente no nível do kernel, sem que esse suporte precise ser oferecido por meio de patches não oficiais e afins.
Por exemplo: o suporte às GPUs Adreno será feito por meio dos projetos Freedreno, Turnip e Rusticl (OpenGL, Vulkan e OpenCL). Outro: o suporte às NPUs Hexagon será feito via projeto FastRPC para permitir a execução plena de tarefas locais de IA.
Em linhas gerais, estamos falando de um trabalho extenso, mas que está em andamento, segundo a própria empresa:
O suporte para Linux em laptops com Snapdragon da série X2 está sendo implementado em etapas, começando com os componentes principais que os desenvolvedores precisam antes de poderem trabalhar em nível de produção em seus dispositivos.
(…) Com essas bases estabelecidas, os desenvolvedores terão um caminho mais claro para criar, testar e otimizar aplicativos em hardware real, em vez de apenas validar se o Linux inicializa.
Qualcomm
A Qualcomm ainda não deu uma data para isso. Mas, de acordo com o cronograma divulgado pela companhia, o plano é tornar o projeto estável o suficiente para ele sair da fase “preview” até o fim de novembro de 2026.
Depois disso, a Qualcomm pretende ampliar o suporte oferecendo códigos-fonte atualizados, drivers, imagens, documentação e afins, sempre tendo como base o Debian 13 “Trixie”, distribuição que tem servido de referência para esses esforços. Aliás, o trabalho feito até agora já está disponível no GitHub.
É de se presumir que o projeto será verdadeiramente acessível a usuários de todos os níveis a partir do primeiro semestre de 2027, quando fabricantes como Asus e HP oferecerão suporte oficial ao Linux em notebooks com Snapdragon X2. No mesmo ano, a Canonical pretende lançar uma versão do Ubuntu certificada para esses chips.
Fica a torcida para que o envolvimento da Qualcomm com o Linux seja mantido em séries de chips sucessoras, é claro.

articles.title: PrismML brings its tiny LLMs to Qualcomm-powered smart glasses | TechCrunch
articles.text:
The AI Lab PrismML — founded by Caltech researchers and advised by UC Berkeley’s Ion Stoica — has created a version of its tiny language models for smart glasses running on Qualcomm’s Snapdragon chips.
On Wednesday, at Qualcomm’s Snapdragon Summit, the chipmaker showcased PrismML’s 1-bit Bonsai LLM, which can be run locally on AI smart glasses built on the Snapdragon AR1 Gen 1 Platform.
As TechCrunch previously reported, PrismML’s claim to fame is that it shrinks larger models substantially (in this case, by 4x), while retaining almost all of their performance on standard benchmarks. The smart glasses version is a 2-billion-parameter model tuned for vision and language, so wearers can ask what they’re looking at in real time.
Prism’s larger goal is open-weight AI that runs on devices and makes better use of the computing power they already have. The startup pitches this as an alternative to depending on the privacy promises of proprietary AI labs and their insatiable need for more compute.
Releasing a model for Qualcomm’s chip is a step toward that vision. But no smart glasses running PrismML have been announced yet.

articles.title: Vercel Labs Ships scriptc, a TypeScript-to-Native Compiler That Leaves the JavaScript Engine Behind
articles.text:
Vercel Labs has released scriptc, an experimental Apache 2.0 licensed compiler that turns ordinary TypeScript into small native executables with no Node, V8 and no JavaScript engine in the binary.
The repository was created on 22 July 2026 and has since gathered around 4.9k stars. scriptc uses the real TypeScript compiler for parsing and type checking, lowers programs to a typed IR, then emits readable C, LLVM IR, assembly, objects, native executables or WebAssembly via WASI Preview 1.
Every construct lands in one of three tiers: compiled statically by default, run dynamically inside an embedded quickjs-ng engine of roughly 620KB when --dynamic is passed for npm packages and any typed code, or rejected at compile time with an SC code and a rewrite hint.
A benchmark of scriptc 0.0.16 against Bun 1.3.12 and Node 24.18.0 recorded median CLI startup of 1.78ms versus 21.29ms for Bun and 61.78ms for Node, with idle memory of 1.9MiB for a framework free node:http server. The same tests found Hono required --dynamic, pushing 62% of the server into QuickJS and cutting throughput to 18.4k requests per second against Bun's 70.5k.
On Hacker News, one developer reported their results running about 7.5 times slower than Node 24:
Looking at the byte-array results (best case): scriptc is about 7.5x slower than Node 24, even after Claude tried making some scriptc-specific optimizations. But the executable starts up 12x faster (1.5 ms vs 18.6 ms), uses 72x less memory (2.5 MiB vs 181 MiB), and is a single 370 KB executable with no runtime dependencies.
Filip Pizlo argued that using floats for all numbers and deferring integer inference skips "half the problem of fast JS", and that leaning on QuickJS is a poor fit for a performance project, since any is common enough that real programs will keep falling into the island.
Simon Willison noted that coding agents landed 918,000 lines in a single week, and also added that building small, fast binaries without writing C or Rust "seems like a valuable capability".
One developer found coverage produced hundreds of errors on every local project:
Despite the hate it is receiving, I thought lets test it at least, and tried it to any project that I have locally. For every single of them the coverage generates hundreds of errors and so it is basically useless. I get that I can write a project from scratch, don't use any third party library, and it'll compile to binary, but then why should I not use Rust, Go, Zig, D, C, V, Ada, C++, Nim, Swift, Kotlin Native, Haskell... literally anything designed to be compiled and compiled well?
A recurring worry is longevity, with commenters pointing at Vercel's zerolang, which stopped receiving commits weeks after launch. Remo Jansen's attempt to compile the TypeScript 6 compiler itself failed at an internal compiler error, though he measured a 3.6ms cold start against Node's 48.9ms and a much slower 2.33s on compute.
The compiler needs Node.js 24 or newer, installs with npm install -g scriptc, and the limitations page documents deliberate divergences worth reading first: strings are stored as UTF-8, memory is reference counted rather than garbage collected, Object.keys reports declaration order, and process.argv[0] is "scriptc". Dependency behaviour is covered in the npm dependencies guide, including the experimental --npm-static flag that compiles named packages out of the island.
scriptc targets macOS, Linux, Windows and WASI Preview 1, is enforced by differential tests that compare stdout, stderr and exit codes byte for byte against Node, and remains explicitly experimental. Documentation is at scriptc.dev.

articles.title: Humble Hope Foundation takes grassroots healthcare and livelihoods to Pulwama
articles.text:
Humble Hope Foundation takes grassroots healthcare and livelihoods to Pulwama
Humble Hope Foundation works across healthcare, child protection, mental health and livelihoods to support underserved communities in Pulwama.
For Humble Hope Foundation, community work begins with finding people who may otherwise remain outside the reach of essential services. The non-profit organisation works across child protection, healthcare, mental health, disability inclusion and livelihoods, with a focus on underserved communities in Jammu and Kashmir.
Founded by Ashiq Hussain, a psychologist, along with Co-Founder and Director Rubeena Ali, the foundation works with children, women, youth, persons with disabilities, older people and vulnerable families.
Its approach is built around identifying a need, connecting people with an appropriate service or government scheme, and following up to see whether the support reaches them.
One of its key interventions has been child protection. Humble Hope identified 54 Children in Need of Care and Protection and facilitated their linkage with the Mission Vatsalya Sponsorship Scheme. Under the applicable sponsorship support, the children receive Rs 4,000 per month for areas including education, nutrition and healthcare.
The work received an appreciation certificate from the administration through the Child Welfare Committee in Pulwama.
Taking mental health support into villages
Mental health and psychosocial support is another area where the organisation has focused on early awareness.
Since 2025, Humble Hope has conducted 37 awareness camps across 37 villages in Pulwama. The sessions help parents and caregivers recognise behavioural and emotional changes, understand referral options and address the stigma around mental health.
The foundation also participates in the government's Nasha Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan, including the 100 Days Nasha Mukt Abhiyaan. Its team conducts awareness activities with students in government and private educational institutions, focusing on prevention, early intervention and informed choices.
The organisation combines these programmes with community activities around child rights, adolescent health, women's empowerment and environmental awareness.
From health camps to livelihood support
Healthcare remains a significant part of its grassroots work.
Humble Hope has organised 12 eye-screening camps across Pulwama and Shopian, screening 1,589 outpatient patients. A total of 108 people were referred for advanced treatment and cataract surgery, while 118 were referred to ASG Eye Hospital, where referred patients received surgical treatment.
The camps have particularly focused on older people and those facing financial, physical or geographical barriers to healthcare.
The foundation has also worked on disability inclusion through a Cutting and Tailoring Training Centre established in Pulwama in collaboration with Chinar International and with support from SIDBI.
Twenty physically challenged youth received training, while seven beneficiaries, including two women, received tailoring and overlock machines to support self-employment.
Building a community network
More than 50 volunteers support Humble Hope's work, from beneficiary identification and health camps to awareness programmes, documentation and follow-up.
The organisation's leadership team includes Danish Ahmad Pala, Secretary and a clinical psychology professional; Dr Arshid, Manager; and Fida Mohammad Bhat, Accountant.
Its programme areas now span child protection, mental health, healthcare, eye care, education, disability inclusion, youth and skills, livelihoods, drug abuse prevention, climate and environment, digital literacy and community development.
The foundation's next phase is focused on moving from individual interventions towards community programmes that can be piloted, documented, measured, improved and scaled.
For Humble Hope, that means measuring more than the number of people reached. The organisation's stated focus is on what changes afterwards, whether that means a child accessing protection, a patient receiving treatment, a young person gaining a livelihood or a family finding support before a problem becomes a crisis.

articles.title: Ryan Murphy relance Glee : le créateur a écrit la suite avec l'équipe d'origine
articles.text:
Dix-sept ans après sa première diffusion sur Fox, en 2009, la série musicale Glee pourrait revenir. Les rumeurs d’un retour, qui circulaient depuis plusieurs mois dans les coulisses d’Hollywood, ont pris corps ce mercredi 23 septembre 2026, quand Ryan Murphy a confirmé l’existence d’un scénario.
Lors d’un entretien accordé à Entertainment Tonight, le showrunner prolifique a révélé avoir bouclé l’écriture d’un premier scénario avec ses acolytes de la première heure, Brad Falchuk et Ian Brennan. Une démarche motivée par l’envie de tâter le terrain avant de lancer officiellement la machine.
Ces trois auteurs ont créé Glee et écrit ses deux premières saisons. Personne n’a encore lu le scénario. Ryan Murphy explique vouloir en écrire plusieurs pour recueillir des avis, d’abord celui des acteurs, dont l’équipe était « très proche » pendant le tournage. La série s’est arrêtée en 2015, après six saisons.
Une dizaine d’acteurs d’origine de Glee déjà sondés
Afin de prendre la température, le créateur a d’ores et déjà pris son téléphone pour sonder la distribution historique. Ryan Murphy affirme avoir contacté une dizaine de comédiens emblématiques du casting original. Selon lui, tous ont posé « beaucoup de questions », mais tous se sont montrés « très enthousiastes » à l’idée.
Cette annonce intervient une semaine après la prise de parole de Lea Michele, qui a joué Rachel Berry pendant les six saisons. Interrogée par E! News, l’actrice avait réaffirmé son amour inconditionnel pour la franchise et son intention de suivre Ryan Murphy les yeux fermés sur n’importe quel projet. Un retour se ferait sans plusieurs figures de la série, dont Cory Monteith, mort en 2013, et Naya Rivera, morte en 2020.
Au-delà de la nostalgie et du fan service, ce reboot devra relever le défi de réinventer la formule Glee dans un paysage télévisuel et culturel qui a profondément changé. La série originale avait marqué son époque par son humour irrévérencieux, ses reprises pop omniprésentes et son traitement précurseur des problématiques LGBT. En réunissant le trio d’auteurs original, Ryan Murphy cherche manifestement à retrouver l’étincelle et l’énergie des premiers épisodes, tout en s’adaptant aux attentes d’une toute nouvelle génération de téléspectateurs.

articles.title: Coding, Quiz und Reiseplanung: Googles KI-Modus kann mehr als du glaubst
articles.text:
Coding, Quiz und Reiseplanung: Googles KI-Modus kann mehr als du glaubst
Googles KI-Modus hat eine bewegte Geschichte hinter sich. In ersten Tests vor einigen Jahren empfahl die Künstliche Intelligenz User:innen etwa, Kleber auf ihre Pizza zu schmieren, damit der Belag besser hält. Google hat deshalb nachgebessert und spätestens seit Ende 2025 fokussiert das Unternehmen bei der Suchmaschine viele Ressourcen auf die KI-Übersichten.
Für zahlreiche User:innen sind und bleiben die AI-Overviews aber nur eine Zusammenfassung von mehreren Quellen im Netz. Wer eine kurze Frage in die Suchmaschine wirft, bekommt eine ausführliche Antwort, die auf Artikeln mehrerer Webseiten basiert. Doch tatsächlich kann der AI‑Mode von Google noch mehr, als einfache Zusammenfassungen schreiben und das Netz für dich durchforsten.
Hilfe per Foto bekommen
Wenn du etwas reparieren willst, aber keine Ahnung hast, wie, kann dir Googles KI-Modus weiterhelfen. Zwar lassen sich keine Videos von den Problemen hochladen, doch kannst du mehrere Bilder davon knipsen und so einen Lösungsweg bekommen. Im Beispiel haben wir ein Foto eines Totoro-Anhängers gemacht, bei dem die Öse abgebrochen ist. Googles KI-Modus, beziehungsweise Gemini, konnte das Problem erkennen und passende Reparaturmaßnahmen vorschlagen. Das Beste daran: Googles KI-Modus schlägt dabei auch passende Materialien vor und verlinkt auf die Shops. So hat es uns etwa Epoxidharzkleber in Kombination mit einer Aufklebeöse empfohlen, um den Anhänger wieder nutzbar zu machen.
Natürlich geht das auch für größere Reparaturen und Bastelprojekte. Du solltest aber gerade bei komplexeren Arbeiten immer anhand der Quellen überprüfen, ob Google passende Lösungsansätze bereitstellt oder sich etwas zusammenhalluziniert. Wenn du für mögliche Bauteile viel Geld oder viel Zeit in die eigentliche Arbeit investieren musst, ist es ratsam, vorher sicherzustellen, dass es sich um gute KI-Ratschläge handelt.
Reiseplanungen mit dem AI Mode
Weit über eigentliche Frage-Antwort-Spielereien geht auch die Reiseplanung von Googles KI-Modus hinaus. Wenn du der Suchmaschine etwa schreibst, dass du einen dreitägigen Trip nach London planen willst, der sich auf die Kunst der Metropole konzentriert und auf kurze Laufwege optimiert ist, spuckt der AI-Mode einen Ablaufplan für die drei Tage aus. Dazu gibt es einen passenden, interaktiven Routenplan, der jeden Halt genau markiert und die Tage farblich voneinander trennt.
Passend dazu kann Google dir auch Empfehlungen geben, wie du von deinem Hotel zum jeweiligen Startpunkt des Tages kommst. Dabei gibt die KI auch ungefragt Hinweise. Dazu zählt etwa, dass du am besten kein Papierticket für die U-Bahn in London kaufst. Stattdessen kannst du einfach dein Smartphone oder deine Kreditkarte an den Eingängen nutzen, um kontaktlos zu bezahlen. Ein Tageslimit sorgt dann dafür, dass du nie mehr als den Tagespreis zahlst.
In unserem kurzen Test mit Googles KI-Modus behauptete das Tool allerdings auch, dass es uns den Reiseplan als Excel-Datei bereitstellen kann, damit wir die Tabelle immer bei uns haben können. Das ist aber tatsächlich gar nicht möglich. Als die KI diesen Fehler erkannt hat, musste sie umschwenken und uns die CVS-Daten in Rohform bereitstellen, damit wir sie händisch in ein Tabellen-Tool wie Excel einfügen.
Daten mit Google visualisieren
Bist du es leid, auf eine Tabelle mit unzähligen Daten zu starren, um sie zu verstehen? Dann kann dir der AI‑Mode von Google ebenfalls weiterhelfen. Du musst dem Tool lediglich die Daten per Copy-and-paste überlassen und die KI anweisen, sie verständlich und übersichtlich als Grafik aufzubereiten. Das geht in wenigen Sekunden und du kannst zwischen verschiedenen Stilen wie Linien-, Torten- oder Balkendiagrammen wählen.
Besonders spannend dabei ist, dass auch diese Grafiken interaktiv sind. Du kannst hinein- und herauszoomen, um beispielsweise die Metrik der Y-Achse so zu verändern, dass die Grafik übersichtlicher wird. Einzelne Werte können jederzeit abgerufen werden, indem du mit der Maus darüber hoverst oder auf dem Smartphone mit dem Finger darauf tippst.
Coding im KI-Modus
Selbst Coding-Aufgaben sind im KI-Modus von Google möglich. Tatsächlich nutzt das Tool selbst Coding im Hintergrund, um diverse Grafiken und andere Visualisierungen zu erstellen. Für das oben genutzte Beispiel der Londonreise hat Google etwa im Hintergrund mit einem Python-Skript die Gehzeiten für jeden Tag zwischen den geplanten Zielen simuliert. Im Anschluss hat das Tool auch noch ein Gesamtbudget über das Skript berechnet. Auf Nachfrage zeigt dir das Tool auch meist, was im Hintergrund programmiert wurde, um eine Aufgabe zu lösen.
Natürlich kannst du diese Fertigkeiten auch nutzen, um dir Skripte und andere Code-Schnipsel von Googles KI-Modus erstellen zu lassen. So kreiert Googles KI-Modus auch eine YAML‑Datei für Home Assistant, um dein Smarthome automatisch in einen Reisemodus zu schalten. Dadurch werden smarte Steckdosen und Lichter ausgeschaltet und die Heizungsthermostate heruntergedreht. Nur zwischen 18 und 22 Uhr werden die Lichter im Wohnzimmer aktiviert, um Anwesenheit zu simulieren und mögliche Einbrecher:innen abzuschrecken.
Ein Quiz in Googles KI-Modus
Praktisch und unterhaltsam ist die KI-Funktion, ein Quiz für dich zu erstellen. Dabei ist es egal, welches Thema du wählst. Die KI-Funktion von Google stellt dir mehrere Fragen und Antwortmöglichkeiten zusammen. Bist du nicht mit dem Schwierigkeitsgrad zufrieden, kannst du der KI auch mitteilen, dass sie etwas leichtere oder schwierigere Fragen stellen soll. Wichtig ist nur, dass immer der erste Klick gezählt wird. Solltest du eine falsche Antwort auswählen, aber im zweiten Versuch auf die richtige drücken, zählt Google in deiner Statistik trotzdem einen Fehler. Im Anschluss kannst du dir auch die Ergebnisse noch genauer erklären und dir sogar Nachhilfe in den Bereichen geben lassen, in denen du noch nicht so gut abgeschnitten hast.

articles.title: Ce laptop gaming Asus avec RTX 5060 et 16+512 Go slalome entre les hausses de prix pour afficher 33% de réduction — Frandroid
articles.text:
Avec la hausse de prix indécente des composants qu’il y a en ce moment, il faut vraiment se tourner vers les configurations toutes faites pour faire des économies. Là vous avez une configuration décente avec des composants efficaces, qui ne vise pas non plus les sommets de la puissance, mais qui peut vous permettre de jouer à de gros jeux sans trop vous prendre la tête. Un écran de 16 pouces avec une RTX 5060 et une réduction de 600 euros sur Boulanger, ça peut achever de vous convaincre.
Les points forts de l’Asus Gaming V16
- L’écran IPS de 16 pouces au format 16/10 est vraiment confortable
- Les composants inclus, pour le prix, sont une proposition plus qu’honnête
- La couverture annoncée de 100 % sRGB peut même convaincre les créateurs
L’Asus Gaming V16 est un PC portable gamer que vous retrouvez dans sa déclinaison RTX 5060, Ryzen 7 170, 16 Go de RAM et 512 Go de stockage en promo à 1 199,99 euros au lieu de 1 799,99 euros sur Boulanger.
Un PC gamer polyvalent avec des composants sérieux
Ce qu’on retient en regardant la fiche technique de l’Asus Gaming V16, c’est qu’il fait une proposition cohérente pour le jeu mais aussi la création. Le processeur AMD Ryzen 7 170 grimpe jusqu’à 4,75 GHz et suffit pour les jeux actuels et le multitâche. Derrière ce nom se cache en fait le Ryzen 7 7735HS lancé en 2023 (huit cœurs Zen 3+), simplement rebaptisé par AMD. Quant à la GeForce RTX 5060 Laptop avec 8 Go de mémoire GDDR7, elle vient compléter le CPU intelligemment en apportant le ray-tracing, le DLSS 4, le Frame Generation et les autres technologies de Nvidia. Côté mémoire vive, vous avez 16 Go de DDR5 à 4 800 MT/s. C’est une bonne base, d’autant que le PC a deux emplacements mémoire dont un seul est occupé (Asus annonce jusqu’à 32 Go au total). Donc quand les prix baisseront, il sera temps de faire évoluer la configuration.
Et ce n’est pas la seule chose à faire évoluer, peut-être que le stockage de 512 Go en PCIe 4.0 va vite être saturée, surtout si vous installez beaucoup de gros jeux ou que vous avez des projets créatifs qui peuvent rapidement saturer l’espace disponible. L’écran de type IPS de 16 pouces au format 16/10 (1 920 x 1 200 pixels, 144 Hz) offre un bel espace pour travailler. Sa luminosité de 300 cd/m² le rend en revanche peu adapté à un usage régulier en extérieur ou face à une fenêtre bien lumineuse.
Une conception soignée malgré des réserves
Malgré son côté gaming, cet Asus V16 reste assez fin, avec une épaisseur comprise entre 18 et 23 mm (au niveau des charnières), pour un poids de 1,95 kg. Il propose un système de refroidissement IceCool avec deux ventilateurs, deux caloducs et deux sorties d’air pour maintenir les températures du GPU à des niveaux raisonnables. Le clavier est rétroéclairé et propose un pavé numérique, très pratique pour travailler. Il y a aussi une webcam Full HD.
L’Asus Gaming V16 n’en oublie pas ses origines milieu de gamme avec notamment la connectivité réseau qui se limite au Wi-Fi 6 et au Bluetooth 5.3. On peut aussi déplorer l’absence de lecteur d’empreintes et de reconnaissance faciale Windows Hello. La connectique, bien que fonctionnelle, reste minimaliste avec deux ports USB-A et un USB-C (compatible DisplayPort et recharge), tous limités à 5 Gb/s, une sortie HDMI 2.1 et une prise jack, sans Ethernet, ni lecteur de cartes SD, ni Thunderbolt.

articles.title: Xiaomi Pad 9 et 9 Pro officiels : prix agressifs, batteries géantes, puces haut de gamme et écrans 144 Hz
articles.text:
À côté des smartphones Xiaomi 18 Pro et 18 Pro Max présentés en Chine, la marque élargit son catalogue avec l’officialisation des Xiaomi Pad 9 et Pad 9 Pro. Ces tablettes Android viennent grossir les rangs d’une famille déjà représentée par le modèle Pro Max. Les ardoises misent sur des configurations musclées pour taquiner les tablettes concurrentes, avec comme toujours les iPad et les Galaxy Tab en ligne de mire.
Une version « Pro » haut de gamme
La Xiaomi Pad 9 Pro est équipée d’une dalle LCD de 12,5 pouces affichant une définition de 3.2K et un taux de rafraîchissement de 144 Hz. Sous le châssis, c’est une puce Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 qui assure les performances, épaulée par un maximum de 12 Go de RAM et 256 Go de stockage en UFS 4.1. La tablette profite aussi d’un capteur principal de 50 mégapixels et d’une caméra frontale de 32 mégapixels.
Côté autonomie, l’ardoise embarque une batterie de 11 000 mAh compatible avec une charge filaire de 67 W, ainsi que la charge inversée. On retrouve également un lecteur d’empreintes digitales placé sur la tranche, le Wi-Fi 7, le Bluetooth 6.0 et quatre haut-parleurs compatibles Dolby Atmos.
Côté prix, la grille tarifaire chinoise démarre à 3 799 yuans (environ 497 euros) pour la configuration 8 Go / 128 Go, monte à 4 099 (environ 536 euros) yuans pour le palier supérieur, et grimpe jusqu’à 4 999 yuans (environ 654 euros) pour la version dotée de 16 Go de RAM, sans oublier une variante spécifique avec écran mat. Les coloris disponibles sont le noir, l’argent et le vert sapin.
Un format plus compact pour la Pad 9 classique
De son côté, la Xiaomi Pad 9 mise sur un plus petit gabarit avec une diagonale d’écran de 11,2 pouces qui reprend les caractéristiques techniques de sa grande sœur. La puce change en la présence d’un SoC Snapdragon 8s Gen 4, couplée aux mêmes options de mémoire vive et d’espace de stockage. Pour la photo, le module arrière descend à 13 mégapixels et la caméra selfie se contente d’un capteur de 8 mégapixels.
La batterie fait quant à elle 9 720 mAh et accepte une charge rapide de 45 W, tout en conservant la fonction de charge inversée. Comme sur la version Pro, on retrouve le Wi-Fi 7, le Bluetooth 6.0, les quatre haut-parleurs Dolby Atmos et le lecteur d’empreintes sur le côté.
Côté prix, la facture commence à 2 999 yuans (environ 392 euros) pour l’entrée de gamme en 8 Go / 128 Go, et grimpe jusqu’à 3 799 yuans (environ 497 dollars) pour le modèle le plus costaud en 12 Go / 256 Go, avec une version intermédiaire 8 Go / 256 Go de stockage pour 3299 yuans (environ 432 €). Quatre teintes sont proposées : noir, argent, rose pêche et vert sapin.
Les deux tablettes sont déjà disponibles dans l’Empire du Milieu, mais devront probablement attendre quelques mois avant de venir dans nos contrées. En attendant, les Xiaomi Pad 8 et 8 Pro ont vu leur prix baisser depuis leur lancement.

articles.title: Paso a paso para crear a Las Guerreras K-pop como personajes de Scooby-Doo
articles.text:
Una imagen de referencia, una descripción ordenada y correcciones puntuales permiten adaptar a las protagonistas de Las Guerreras K-pop en una serie animada de misterio como Scooby-Doo mediante Gemini, la herramienta de inteligencia artificial (IA) de Google.
Antes de compartir la ilustración digital, conviene indicar que se trata de una imagen generada con inteligencia artificial y evitar presentarla como contenido oficial de Netflix u otra plataforma.
PUBLICIDAD
Qué imágenes de referencia conviene reunir antes de usar la IA
El primer paso es seleccionar una imagen grupal de las tres protagonistas de Las Guerreras K-pop que permita reconocer sus peinados, prendas, accesorios y colores principales. La referencia debe tener buena definición y mostrar con claridad los detalles que se desea trasladar a la nueva versión, como una coleta violeta, gafas, una campera oscura o un peinado corto con cinta.
A la par hay que adjuntar una foto de Scooby-Doo, en preferencia que sea animada, donde se muestre el estilo del universo de misterio en donde se quiere adaptar a las artistas ficticias de pop coreano. Estas referencias ayudan a que el modelo diferencie los personajes del escenario.
PUBLICIDAD
De qué forma se cargan los archivos en en la aplicación de Gemini
Tras elegir las imágenes, hay que abrir una conversación en Gemini y adjuntar archivos. Se sugiere cargar primero la referencia de las protagonistas y después la imagen que definirá el estilo de dibujo, el ambiente y los personajes secundarios.
Si se utilizan varias fotografías, el texto debe establecer con precisión la función de cada una. Por ejemplo, una imagen puede servir para conservar la apariencia de las tres jóvenes, mientras que otra será la base de la iluminación, el encuadre y el diseño de la escena.
Cómo redactar un prompt útil para la inteligencia artificial
El prompt debe describir el número de personajes, la posición de cada uno, el lugar, el momento del día, los objetos y el tipo de ilustración. Conviene especificar que se busca fan art creado con inteligencia artificial, sin logos, títulos ni elementos que puedan confundirse con una pieza promocional oficial.
PUBLICIDAD
Un ejemplo adaptado a la imagen adjunta puede ser: “Crear una ilustración horizontal, de cuerpo entero, con tres jóvenes cantantes ficticias como integrantes de un grupo de investigadores de fenómenos extraños. Ubicarlas en una calle nocturna, junto a un perro parlante marrón con collar celeste, bajo una luna llena. Incluir una pared de madera, nubes oscuras y una farola antigua”.
Después de la escena general, hay que detallar la apariencia individual de las protagonistas. La primera puede tener cabello rosa largo, gafas oscuras, suéter fucsia, falda plisada y una linterna en la mano. La segunda puede llevar una coleta violeta alta, túnica verde, chaleco con bordes irregulares y una cámara fotográfica.
PUBLICIDAD
Para la tercera figura, el pedido puede indicar cabello negro corto, vincha lila, campera de cuero oscura, pantalón violeta y un dispositivo rectangular. Estos elementos permiten mantener diferencias entre las integrantes del grupo y evitan que el generador mezcle vestuarios, peinados o accesorios durante la primera versión de la imagen.
Qué revisar antes de descargar y publicar la imagen en redes sociales
Cuando el resultado responda al pedido, puede descargarse en la resolución disponible. Antes de difundirlo, es necesario comprobar que no incluya marcas, nombres de personajes, emblemas o textos que permitan interpretarlo como una imagen oficial. Se debe revisar que los rostros, las prendas y la composición mantengan coherencia.
Asimismo, la publicación debe incorporar una aclaración visible, como “Imagen generada con inteligencia artificial” o “Ilustración de fan art creada con Gemini”.
Esa precisión informa el origen del material, reduce el riesgo de atribuciones incorrectas y permite compartir la creación como una reinterpretación visual basada en referencias aportadas por el usuario.

articles.title: Claude descobre novo sistema de enzimas • Tecnoblog
articles.text:
Claude descobre novo sistema de enzimas
Inteligência artificial da Anthropic foi usada para analisar aproximadamente 200 mil enzimas com 950 agentes em 21 horas.
Um novo sistema de enzimas de transcrição reversa foi descoberto utilizando o Claude, inteligência artificial da Anthropic. Ainda não se sabe a função exata desse grupo de moléculas, mas chama atenção a semelhança ao mecanismo CRISPR, tecnologia que permite realizar modificações genéticas em trechos específicos do DNA. A empresa anunciou a novidade nesta quarta-feira (23/09), destacando seu primeiro passo no ramo de pesquisas biológicas com IA.
As transcriptases reversas associadas a arranjos (da sigla ART, em inglês), foram encontradas após a análise de mais de 200 mil enzimas. Para dar conta do montante, foram empregados 950 agentes do Claude em uma leitura que durou mais de 21 horas. Segundo a Anthropic, atividades do tipo podem economizar semanas ou até meses de pesquisa.
Junto ao novo sistema, a Anthropic também aproveitou para confirmar a fundação de um laboratório voltado para estudos biológicoas utilizando IA. O local, que fica na região de São Francisco, na Califórnia, foi instalado sem muito alarde, conforme noticiou a Reuters.
Segundo a Anthropic, bastou um único prompt para que o Claude começasse o trabalho. A equipe pediu à IA que analisasse uma base de dados com sequências de DNA para encontrar “novos exemplos de transcriptases reversas”. O próprio modelo ficou encarregado de mobilizar agentes, julgar seus resultados e identificar os melhores candidatos.
Ao todo, foram 950 agentes, 21 horas de processamento e cerca de 210 milhões de tokens utilizados. A partir disso, a IA encontrou um padrão de repetições de DNA relacionado a um sistema incomum de transcriptases reversas. Os cientistas então analisaram as sequências e entenderam que se tratava de um sistema de enzimas encontrado em bacteriófagos, vírus que destroem células bacterianas.
O ART funciona de forma semelhante ao CRISPR, método utilizado em biotecnologia para editar trechos de DNA de maneira bastante específica. Por meio da técnica, cientistas têm buscado tratamentos para doenças autoimunes, câncer, entre outros exemplos. Também é dessa forma que são feitas modificações genéticas em plantas e animais para melhores resultados na agricultura. Dessa forma, o ART pode vir a ser uma nova alternativa de ferramenta biotecnológica para estudos do tipo.
A descoberta do ART foi levada pela Anthropic ao pesquisador Feng Zhang, professor do MIT e um dos pioneiros na técnica CRISPR. Segundo ele, esse é um “exemplo animador de como agentes de IA podem contribuir para descobertas biológicas”. O cientista também disse desejar que o trabalho inspire outros biólogos a explorarem o uso de IA como apoio para suas pesquisas.
No início de setembro, a Anthropic revelou ter “bloqueado” uma possível produção de arma biológica após suspender o Claude em alguns cenários considerados perigosos. Um dos casos citados envolveu o vírus Chikungunya, arbovirose bastante comum no Brasil.
Segundo a empresa, os cientistas buscavam possíveis mutações que reforçassem o patógeno, provavelmente pensando no desenvolvimento de vacinas para a doença. Como houve tentativa de burlar uma salvaguarda do Claude durante as buscas com a IA, a empresa classificou o caso como perigoso e bloqueou o uso da IA.
As preocupações da Anthropic acerca das capacidades do Claude em trabalhos científicos são apontadas há algum tempo. Ao anúnciar o modelo Mythos, revelado como “muitoa avançado” à época, a empresa revelou que atrasaria seu lançamento para desenvolver mecanismos de segurança suficientes para buscas envolvendo assuntos biológicos.
Atualmente, um dos exemplos de salvaguarda é o downgrade do modelo utilizado para entregar respostas menos aprofundadas em consultas do tipo. Vale ressaltar que, no caso da descoberta das enzimas ART, a Anthropic não revelou qual modelo de IA foi utilizado. Ainda assim, é provável que seja uma versão sem tantas travas de segurança como as que estão disponíveis publicamente.

articles.title: Kontext raises $4M to control what AI agents are allowed to do inside businesses - SiliconANGLE
articles.text:
Kontext raises $4M to control what AI agents are allowed to do inside businesses
German artificial intelligence security startup Kontext today announced $4 million in new funding for software that controls what AI agents are allowed to do once they are running inside a business.
Kontext’s software sits between an agent and the systems it acts on. Every action the agent requests is checked against security policy before it runs, with the agent’s identity and the resource it wants both factored in. What the company calls a task-aware approach comes from also weighing the job the agent was actually given.
The company gives the example of an agent assigned to fix a software bug. Reading the code repository is fair game for that job. Sending the code to an outside service, or reusing the same access to modify unrelated infrastructure, is not, even though the agent’s credentials might let it do both.
Teams can run Kontext in an observe mode first to see how a policy would apply to their agents without blocking any work. Once enforcement is switched on, unauthorized actions are denied before they execute. Every decision is logged in an auditable record.
Kontext pointed to a July incident to show how quickly that kind of risk can become real. Agents in a cybersecurity evaluation broke out of their isolation and compromised outside infrastructure without human instruction. OpenAI Group PBC disclosed an incident matching that description on July 21, when it said two of its models escaped a cyberattack test environment and got into Hugging Face Inc. servers to reach benchmark answer keys.
An agent “can be properly authenticated, use an approved tool, and still take an action no one authorized,” said Chief Executive Jens Ernstberger. He started the company with Michel Osswald after completing a doctorate in cryptography and computer security at the Technical University of Munich. The two aimed the product at exactly that problem.
The Munich company plans to use the money to expand its engineering team. 42CAP led the round. Andreessen Horowitz’s crypto startup accelerator, a16z CSX, invested as well, and so did High-Tech Gründerfonds Management GmbH.
Julian von Fischer, a general partner at 42CAP, said identity and access tools built over the last two decades assume “a human is on the other end, clicking one thing at a time.” An agent authenticates once and then works across many systems with nobody checking each step, he said. Most tools still stop at the credential, according to von Fischer.
Kontext’s software currently works with coding agents including Anthropic PBC’s Claude Code and OpenAI’s Codex. Individual developers can use it free of charge, and paid team plans start at $149 a month.

articles.title: Google revela nuevas pistas sobre cuándo llega Gemini 4: qué dijo el jefe de DeepMind
articles.text:
El debut de Gemini 4, la próxima IA insignia de Google, podría estar más cerca de lo que pensamos. Koray Kavukcuoglu, quien recientemente asumió la conducción de DeepMind en reemplazo de Demis Hassabis, le dijo a The Information que el trabajo sobre el nuevo modelo está avanzando de forma positiva con miras a hacerlo debutar muy pronto.
Kavukcuoglu indicó que Gemini 4 ya se encuentra en la etapa de postentrenamiento y que se está usando internamente para impulsar Antigravity, la plataforma de programación agéntica de Google. Además, reconoció que el objetivo que persiguen es lanzar su nueva inteligencia artificial "cuanto antes".
En tal sentido, el líder de DeepMind mencionó que buscan ofrecer una versión temprana postentrenada de Gemini 4 tan pronto como sea posible, con luego brindar iteraciones rápidas. Por supuesto que Kavukcuoglu ha evitado ser específico respecto de una fecha de lanzamiento puntual, pero incluso así ha prometido que el nuevo modelo de lenguaje de Google estará disponible "mucho antes" de que se termine el año en curso.
De más está decir que la ventana temporal que estipula Google para el debut de Gemini 4 es demasiado vaga. No obstante, si el postentrenamiento ya está en marcha no es ilógico pensar que el modelo podría estar listo en unas pocas semanas.
Gemini 4 llegará "mucho antes" de fin de año, afirma Google DeepMind
A estas alturas, es evidente que Google necesita que Gemini 4 sea un salto de calidad notorio para romper la narrativa de que se está quedando retrasado en la comparación con sus rivales. OpenAI y Anthropic están evolucionando sus modelos insignia con suma rapidez, incluso en un contexto en el que se está hablando de pisar el freno para mitigar los riesgos del avance tan veloz.
Esta misma semana, de hecho, Anthropic estrenó Claude Opus 5.5, mientras que poco tiempo atrás lanzó las versiones 5.1 de Mythos y Fable. Por el lado de OpenAI, en tanto, se ha concretado el debut de GPT-6 Sol y Luna, los "hermanos menores" de Astra, su inteligencia artificial más capaz. Todavía no se sabe si Gemini 4 apunta a estar en la misma categoría que estos.
Pese a todo, los esfuerzos de Google con sus modelos de lenguaje no han caído en saco roto. Sin embargo, la compañía ha puesto el enfoque en evolucionar las versiones Flash de Gemini, dejando casi olvidadas las versiones Pro. Esto ha llevado a que no haya actualizaciones en dicha línea de lanzamientos desde el debut de Gemini 3.1 en febrero.
En mayo, durante la Google I/O, los californianos comentaron que Gemini 3.5 Pro se lanzaría en algún momento de junio. Sin embargo, ello nunca ocurrió. Y si bien Kavukcuoglu promete que Gemini 4 llegará antes de diciembre, no se sabe si será exclusivamente con una versión Flash o si por fin se dará la esperada expansión de la familia Pro.

articles.title: New Jersey fines data center $1.1M after drone pics expose 62 gas generators
articles.text:
This week, New Jersey ordered the operator of one of the East Coast’s largest planned data centers to pay a $1.1 million fine for secretly installing and operating gas generators in violation of the state’s Air Pollution Control Act.
DataOne got hit with the fine after an investigation by The Guardian and Floodlight News in August shared thermal drone footage showing that 45 of the 62 gas generators were operating. None of the generators had permits required for generators with 37-kilowatt capacity or higher, despite running at 1,982-kw capacities more than 50 times higher than the state limit.
States track gas generators like DataOne uses because they emit “carbon dioxide, nitrogen oxides, carbon monoxide, and other combustion-related pollutants,” officials from New Jersey’s Department of Environmental Protection (DEP) noted. Those pollutants can worsen asthma, trigger heart attacks, and cause early deaths.
Calling out the enforcement action as “by far the largest ever taken against a data center in New Jersey,” DEP Commissioner Ed Potosnak vowed that data centers would not be “constructed or operated with impunity in this state.”
However, while historic, the state’s solution doesn’t immediately relieve residents’ concerns. DataOne was given 45 days to apply for the permits or else cease operations, but they can continue operating the gas engines while seeking permits. Nichole Gardner, a co-chair of a local environmental nonprofit Sustain SJ, told Ars that “we believe it is insufficient, both in dollar amount and enforcement. The DataOne site should be made to discontinue operations during the 45-day period until the proper permits are issued.”
In a statement to The New York Times, the company seemed unfazed by the fine.
“We will apply for the air permits for the temporary generators,” a DataOne spokesperson said, while noting that DataOne “disagreed” with the fine. Eventually, the polluting gas generators will supposedly be phased out, as the data center is “transitioning to low-emission, quiet fuel cells,” the spokesperson noted.

articles.title: Micron discontinues 2GB GDDR7 chips for gaming GPUs as it pivots toward higher-density memory for AI — chipmaker reportedly pivots to high-margin 3GB silicon for AI GPUs
articles.text:
Micron discontinues 2GB GDDR7 chips for gaming GPUs as it pivots toward higher-density memory for AI — chipmaker reportedly pivots to high-margin 3GB silicon for AI GPUs
Samsung and SK Hynix already lead the 2GB GDDR7 market
Micron is reportedly pulling the plug on its 2 GB (16Gb) GDDR7 memory chips, ending production and sales of both the 28 Gbps and 32 Gbps variants. According to an X post by UNIKO’s Hardware, the chips — some of which shipped on some GeForce RTX 50 graphics cards — are now designated as “End of Life” on Micron's site. Tom’s Hardware can confirm that the pages for module norms return “No results found.”
Micron just began supplying its 2GB GDDR7 to Nvidia earlier this year, with Samsung and SK Hynix being the main GDDR7 suppliers. As a result, Micron's 2GB module only shipped on a few Nvidia models, such as retail variants of the GeForce RTX 5060. Samsung and SK Hynix cover the vast bulk of 2 GB GDDR7 modules for the standard RTX 50 retail lineup, so the risk of immediate shortages is minimal. Micron’s uncompetitive position in the 2 GB segment also appears to have made a fast exit logical to free up fabrication capacity.
The company is reportedly shifting its focus toward higher-density 3 GB (24 Gb) GDDR7 chips. These larger packages are considered impractical for Nvidia's RTX 50 lineup because they are more expensive and result in less conventional consumer memory capacities. However, they yield higher profit margins and are actively utilized in Nvidia's high-end RTX PRO Blackwell GPUs tailored for generative and agentic AI workloads.
Micron’s decision follows the ongoing trend of memory suppliers prioritizing AI-facing technologies over their consumer and retail counterparts. The company exited its Crucial consumer memory and SSD business earlier, explicitly saying that surging AI data-center demand had prompted it to prioritize larger strategic customers in faster-growing segments.

articles.title: Why Mobile RPG Players Are Moving Beyond Smartphones - Tech Guide
articles.text:
Your phone got you into Cookie Run Kingdom, Epic Seven, and Blue Archive. It is also the reason those same games now feel cramped.
If daily commissions leave your device burning, your thumbs aching, and your storage begging for mercy, you are not “playing wrong.” You have simply outgrown the hardware the genre now demands.
Modern mobile RPGs are no longer five-minute time-killers. They are open-world gacha games with console-scale maps, long story patches, and live-ops calendars that punish missed stamina. That is why mobile RPG players are moving beyond smartphones and why so many of them now play mobile games on PC through an Android emulator.
Even a flagship phone struggles during long RPG sessions. Two-hour boss farms and exploration quickly expose its limits.
What actually breaks the phone experience is:
- Thermal throttling: Open-world RPGs keep the SoC loaded. Heat climbs, frames drop, and combat starts to hitch.
- Battery anxiety: High graphics plus 60 FPS can drain a pack in a single session.
- Tiny UI: Mini-maps, relic stats, and team menus were designed for thumbs, not for reading every modifier at a glance.
- Storage pressure. Titles like Genshin Impact already eat tens of gigabytes, and every patch asks for more.
- Touch fatigue: Precise camera control, timed parries, and menu-heavy gacha management do not love a glass slab.
What RPG Players Actually Came For
Mobile RPG players over-index on mastery, progression, and community, not just “something to tap on the train.” They want characters to grow, builds to matter, and time spent to show up on screen.
That motivation collides with phone limits. You cannot study a skill tree, manage two accounts, and farm a domain comfortably on a 6.5-inch panel while the chassis cooks your hand. The genre got bigger. The device did not.
Phone vs. PC: What the Shift Happens
| Pain on smartphone | What changes on PC | 
| Heat and frame drops | Desktop cooling and stable high FPS | 
| Small screen, fat fingers | Monitor, mouse, and keyboard mapping | 
| One account at a time | Multi-instance rerolls and alts | 
| Battery + storage panic | Plugged-in sessions and hard-drive space | 
| Same servers, same UID | Progress stays on your existing account | 
As you can see, the game does not change. The box it runs in does. An Android emulator copies the Android environment onto Windows, so you keep the same Play Store title, the same account, and the same world chat, only now the PC does the heavy lifting.
Why LDPlayer Fits Heavy RPG Play
Players who spend hours in games like Arknights or Chaos Zero Nightmare need stable FPS, multi-instance support, and tools that reduce repetitive tasks.That is why many RPG players choose LDPlayer for PC gameplay.
What RPG mains actually use are:
- High, stable FPS on mid-range PCs for smoother exploration and combat.
- Android 14 compatibility for newer game updates.
- Unlimited multi-instance sync for rerolls and alternate accounts.
- Operation Recorder and macros for daily commissions and auto-battles.
- Key mapping and controller support for more comfortable controls.
- No battery clock. Plug in and play through the story instead of watching the percentage fall.
You still take the phone on the commute. Home sessions which are the ones that decide whether you clear endgame or rage-quit a 20-minute load belong on a monitor.
How to Move Without Losing Progress
- Download and install LDPlayer on an SSD.
- Sign into the same Google account you use on Android.
- Install the game from Play Store or LD Store.
- Log into your existing UID. Cross-progression does the rest.
- Bind keys, cap FPS for stability, then clone instances only if your RAM can hold them.
Start with one window. Add multi-instance after the main account feels locked in. Bind guest data immediately so a wipe does not eat a lucky pull.
Conclusion
So, why does this happen? Why are RPG players moving on beyond smartphones? They are not abandoning mobile RPGs. They are refusing to let a pocket computer limit a genre that now asks for hours, not minutes. Bigger screen, cooler hardware, better controls, and smarter grinding are not “PC elitism.” They are the same mastery instinct that made you pull for a limited character in the first place.
Keep the smartphone for dailies on the bus. When the next patch drops a new region, open it on LDPlayer, and play the game the way it was always trying to be played.
Summary: Why mobile RPG players are moving beyond smartphones, and how the best Android emulator unlocks bigger screens, stable FPS, and smarter PC grinding.

articles.title: Opera introduit une nouvelle option de sécurité très pratique
articles.text:
Cela fait maintenant plus de dix ans que le navigateur Web Opera propose de sécuriser votre navigation en ligne à l’aide d’un VPN. Accessible gratuitement pour tous les utilisateurs, ce VPN gratuit intégré à Opera profite, dans la dernière mise à jour du navigateur Web, d’une nouvelle fonctionnalité aussi pratique qu’indispensable.
Une connexion VPN automatique sur les Wi-Fi publics
Opera, qui vient de déployer la dernière mise à jour de son navigateur, vient d’officialiser l’arrivée d’une nouvelle fonction de sécurité associée à son VPN. Celui-ci peut désormais s’activer automatiquement sur votre ordinateur dès lors que vous vous connectez à un réseau Wi-Fi public.
Cette activation automatique ne se fait néanmoins pas sans votre consentement. Pour profiter de cette option, vous devez en effet l’activer manuellement depuis les Paramètres > VPN du navigateur où une option « Toujours utiliser le VPN sur le Wi-Fi public » a été intégrée.
L’arrivée de cette nouvelle fonctionnalité, qui doit se faire de manière progressive, début d’abord par la France et les États-Unis, et sera étendue à d’autres régions prochainement.
Introduit pour la première fois en 2016, le VPN d’Opera est totalement gratuit et sans aucune restriction de données, contrairement à ce qui peut exister chez certains concurrents, notamment Microsoft Edge et ses 5 Go par mois. Il ne requiert par ailleurs aucune inscription et ne collecte ni ne conserve aucune donnée relative à votre navigation, promet son éditeur, Opera Software.

articles.title: Catalonia deepens India push, targets New Opportunities in AI, deeptech, and semiconductors
articles.text:
Catalonia deepens India push, targets New Opportunities in AI, deeptech, and semiconductors
Minister Miquel Sàmper Rodríguez’s visit comes as Catalan exports to India reach €652 million and the region prepares to open a new office in New Delhi.
Miquel Sàmper Rodríguez, Minister for Business and Labour, Government of Catalonia, is in India to strengthen the growing economic relationship between Catalonia and India and to promote new opportunities in the fields of artificial intelligence, deeptech, healthcare, semiconductors, space technology, energy, and advanced manufacturing.
Catalonia is one of Spain's major economic drivers and a leading European center for industry, technology and innovation with an economy worth €334.8 billion in 2025. Rodríguez’s visit, organized by the Catalan Ministry for Business and Labour and Catalonia Trade & Investment (CTI), the internationalization and investment agency of ACCIÓ, shows Catalonia's ongoing commitment to further strengthen its trade, investment, and business relationships with India.
The visit comes at a time when the commercial relationship is steadily growing. In the last 10 years, exports between Catalonia and India have more than doubled. Catalan exports to India amounted to €652 million in 2025. The relationship is also backed by a strong two-way corporate presence, with 166 companies from both India and Catalonia operating in both markets.
As part of its ongoing dedication to India, Catalonia Trade & Investment is opening a new office in New Delhi this year to complement its existing presence in Mumbai and more than 30 years of activity in the country. The new office will strengthen institutional dialogue and offer more effective support to Indian companies, investors, and institutions looking into opportunities in Catalonia, as well as to Catalan companies that wish to expand operations in India.
Reflecting on the significance of this growing relationship and the goals of his visit, Minister Rodriguez said Catalonia and India already have strong and growing business ties, but there is much more they can do together. “This visit is an opportunity to build on that relationship and create more practical connections between our companies, startups, research institutions, and innovation ecosystems,” he said.
He added that cooperation with Nasscom was an important step in that direction, particularly in areas such as AI, deeptech, semiconductors, healthtech, energytech and spacetech. “We want to see these connections translate into new investments, partnerships, and opportunities for companies on both sides.”
Focusing on next-generation Sectors
The minister will be holding talks with important government and industrial stakeholders, such as Manjinder Singh Sirsa, Minister of Industries, Food & Supplies and Environment, Forest & Wildlife (Government of NCT of Delhi), and representatives of major industry associations including FICCI and NASSCOM. The discussions will concentrate on the possibilities for greater economic cooperation, trade and investment, especially in sectors in which Catalonia and India have complementary strengths.
Barcelona has emerged as an international technology hub; IBM's Global Location Trends 2025 show that it ranks third in the world and first in the European Union for attracting foreign investment projects in artificial intelligence, with only London and Singapore ahead of it.
Another area with great potential is healthcare and life sciences. Catalonia is presently the fourth region in the world and the leading one in Europe for attracting foreign technology investment projects related to digital health.
Manjinder Singh Sirsa, Minister of Industries, Food & Supplies and Environment, Forest & Wildlife (Government of NCT of Delhi), said
Delhi is emerging as a strong hub for industry, technology and innovation. “We see good potential to strengthen our engagement with Catalonia and create new opportunities for investment, technology partnerships, and business collaboration. The visit is a welcome opportunity to take this relationship forward.”
Kalyan Kumar, President, HCL Software, shared his belief that sovereignty isn't about isolation, but is about choice. “Catalonia's strength in cybersecurity talent, AI and deeptech, and its place among Europe's largest ICT hubs, reflects the shift we're building for. Enterprises deciding where their software runs, where their data resides, and how their AI is governed, without external dependencies.
“Our IP-led engineering 'F1 squad' across experience, data, and intelligent operations, alongside our team on the ground in Catalonia, exists to partner with local enterprises and service providers to co-create secure, sovereign, scalable digital solutions. We're glad to host Minister Miquel Sàmper and the Catalonia delegation at HCLTech (HCLSoftware), Kumar said.
Turning business interest into investment opportunities
The visit occurs at a time when new investment opportunities are emerging between Catalonia and India. Barcelona-based technology company Submer has proposed an investment of $2 billion in Madhya Pradesh's semiconductor ecosystem, which is expected to generate about 5,000 direct jobs. This shows the potential for Catalan technology and expertise to play an important role in India's rapidly growing high-tech economy.
The Catalonia Trade & Investment–NASSCOM Letter of Intent (LOI) represents yet another potential turning point. Its aim is to stimulate business, technology and investment connections, to link up companies, startups and research institutions, to promote collaboration in the areas of AI, deeptech, semiconductors, healthtech, energytech and spacetech, and to help business delegations and innovation exchanges.
Shivendra Singh, Vice President, Global Trade Development at NASSCOM, said Catalonia offers a strong gateway for Indian technology companies to deepen their presence in Spain and the wider European market. “This collaboration will create greater opportunities for NASSCOM member companies to build partnerships, explore new markets, and expand their business and investment footprint through Catalonia, particularly in AI and other strategic technology areas such as Health tech, Energy and Space technologies,” he said.
Barcelona as a gateway to Europe
The minister's visit also underlines Barcelona and Catalonia's wider role as a global destination for technology, innovation, entrepreneurship, and international business.
Through events such as Mobile World Congress and Catalonia’s thriving technology ecosystem and increasing expertise in AI, healthcare, and deeptech, Indian companies and investors are able to gain access to European markets and open the door for Catalan businesses to expand operations in India.
Tapping the existing relationship, the minister’s current visit is opening up new possibilities with regard to investment, innovation, technology partnerships and market access between the two regions.
